subject: prd/plan-new
statement: If If projection fails partway (tracker API error, permission refusal, interruption), then the system shall halt without retry storms, emit the projection report naming what exists and what failed, and leave the tracker in a state from which re-running converges
fit_criterion: injected failures at each projection step: report accurate, re-run converges (FR-18's fixtures), zero retry loops beyond a stated bound
